title: Regents Scholarship Program
text: UCLA's Regents Scholarship Program awards up to 100 full-tuition scholarships every year. The top 1.5% of the entering freshmen applicant pool are invited by the Faculty Committee on Honors, Awards and Prizes and the Financial Aid Scholarship Office to compete for the UCLA Regents scholarship. Students then go through a further application process and are selected on the basis of demonstrated academic excellence, leadership and exceptional promise. More information about the financial aspect and selection process can be found at fao.ucla.edu and more information about the program and the Regents Scholar Society can be found at rssla.org.
